results.title: Teambuilding 2
results.overview: After barely surviving a team-building retreat that tested not only their social skills but also their mental health, Horia and the gang are now part of an elite team trying to sell a groundbreaking new product: AI de PLM.

results.title: Not A Love Story
results.overview: Alec and Chenoa rediscover their friendship after 10 years apart. But family feuds bring them unimaginable tragedy. They overcome the anger and heartbreak and eventually acknowledge their love for each other and find reconciliation.

results.title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
results.original_title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
results.overview: On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset, and work ethic that made him one of the most legendary artists of his time.

results.title: Soundweave
results.overview: At the end of a lost village, a lost father, and lost memory, there is a sound that shall not disappear.

results.title: Nothing Has Happened Yet
results.overview: Eunyul possesses a special ability to glimpse what lies ahead for her - but only when she sits on a certain bench on her home island of Geoje. Carrying Robert Walser's The Walk, a gift from an ex-lover, Eunyul returns to her hometown. There, she meets her senior Minjeong and Minjeong's partner Jigeun, someone who remains a painful memory for Eunyul. A stranger also travels through. And in these encounters, she comes face to face with herself.

results.title: The Clouds of Odessa
results.overview: February 24, 2022. Veronika Vasylyeva, a Ukrainian film director and screenwriter, falls into a state of deep sadness over what is happening in her country and the uncertainty surrounding her future in cinema. During the war, she begins to think about the film she had always wanted to make, one she may never be able to bring to life: a love story.

results.title: Towards Jimagawod
results.overview: Inspired by the oceanic novel Black Wings by Taiwanese Indigenous Yami/Tao writer Syaman Rapongan, this immersive documentary transforms audience readings through AI speech recognition-driven response into a collective literary ritual, resonating with the author’s voice and memories between MR and projection space.

results.title: The Double
results.overview: Inspired by Andersen’s tale, The Double follows a Scientist who releases his shadow, only to see it gain autonomy, power, and eventually replace him. Across ten tableaux of about two minutes each, the 20–30 minute experience traces this transformation through a sequence of dreamlike scenes blending realism and abstraction.

results.title: Sweet Dreams
results.overview: Twenty-five-year-old influencer Elena wakes up in her room, her world blurred by the side effects of medication and fragmented memories. Confined within this enclosed space, audiences embody Elena, piece together clues step by step, and unearth a heartbreaking, cruel truth. As traumatic memories come rushing back like a tidal wave, Elena must confront her past. This time, the audience will make the choice for her: to succumb to an endless cycle of agony, or to bravely step into an unknown future.

results.title: RETSU (The Line)
results.overview: Before he knew it, the man found himself standing in a strange line. There was no beginning in sight, and no end to be found. The man was a biologist. Dreaming of one day making a historic discovery and earning worldwide acclaim, he was conducting research to determine whether apes possess intelligence.  Ahead of him stood an unfamiliar businessman, a woman in a purple dress, and a young man in the same work clothes as his own. He feels as though he might know them, but he can’t quite place them. It seems to be a mutual feeling; none of them have any idea why they’re standing in this line. In a society of constant competition and comparison, how are we supposed to live? And is it even possible to escape this strange line? A story that forces us to confront our way of life in a human society where we cannot escape comparing ourselves to others.

results.title: My Time Machine
results.overview: Adam is a young boy with Asperger's syndrome growing up in the aftermath of World War I. Inspired by H. G. Wells' The Time Machine, he dreams of traveling to the future and isolates himself in an old silo to build a time machine. Years later, he finally completes it, but it explodes upon activation. As Adam leaves the silo, he discovers a mud wall bearing a message carved by his mother. Stepping outside, he is astonished by the sight of cars, airplanes, and skyscrapers. Has he simply reached the future through the passage of time, or has he truly traveled through time and space?

results.title: After the Shell
results.overview: Inspired by a near-death experience, AFTER THE SHELL is a 360° film in which you become a drifting soul, suspended between the disappearance of one world and the rebirth of another. Guided by a distant glow, you travel through an immaculate landscape where Nature slowly awakens. Immerse yourself in this sensorial journey and let the light surround you : where will it lead you?

results.title: The Venue
results.overview: A clinical trial briefly ends participants' lives to uncover what lies beyond death. Instead of oblivion, they arrive somewhere no one expected. Through an immersive journey driven by music and sensation, The Venue transforms the afterlife into a celebration of existence.

results.title: SILIQ
results.overview: Set in a near future, SILIQ follows an advanced drone prototype on a classified cargo delivery mission across Taiwan. As it navigates landscapes through machine vision, it witnesses traditional rituals, everyday traditions, and traces of a rapidly changing world. Processing these encounters beyond its original programming, SILIQ begins to question the nature of memory, spirituality, and consciousness. Blending speculative science fiction with Taiwanese mythology, the film explores whether an artificial intelligence can develop its own understanding of humanity, and ultimately make choices beyond the intentions of its creators.

results.title: Kamukuwaká - The Call of the Forest
results.overview: Created by Indigenous director Piratá Waurá with producers Studio Kwo XR, Kamukuwaká takes us deep into the Amazon to the struggle of the Wauja people. Stewards of Brazil's first demarcated indigenous territory, they defend their homeland against farmers, loggers, wildfires and climate change. Drawing on ancient myths and their hyperconnected youth, the Wauja stand as a beacon of resilience. Through intimate 360° filming and 3D scanned environments, Piratá brings his people's wisdom in their Arawak language to global audiences, so we may reconnect to Nature as we face an uncertain future.

results.title: Banda - Harmony of the Everyday
results.overview: Seven characters whose stories intertwine and collide in the squares of small towns, where the town band's music is more than just a pastime: it is an invisible network that unites people, bridging generational gaps and keeping the true soul of the communities alive.

results.title: Kitti
results.overview: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

results.title: Petros Eni
results.overview: In an immersion into the little-known Necropolis upon which the foundations of St. Peter's Basilica rest, we will learn the story of the tomb of the first apostle. The first Pope, the "rock" upon which all of Christianity was built and which has cemented the history not only of the Catholic religion, but of all Western civilization. A fascinating journey through a sacred place that has survived for millennia and whose history is intertwined with the life of the apostle himself and the construction of the Basilica, which in 2026, when Petros Eni arrives in the rooms, will celebrate the 400th anniversary of its inauguration.

results.title: A Lonely Night
results.overview: Samantha’s neighbor confesses that he spies on her at night. Disturbed and seized by a strange feeling, the 38 years old chemistry teacher finds herself caught between fear and curiosity.

results.title: Akshara
results.overview: Akshara is an emotional social-family drama that explores women’s identity, relationships, family values, and social challenges. The story follows a woman’s journey through emotional struggles, relationship conflicts, and societal expectations while searching for her own identity and choices.
